artworks.dimensions:
image/sheet (each): 8 × 7.7 cm (3 1/8 × 3 1/16 in.)
mount: 8.9 × 17.8 cm (3 1/2 × 7 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: This is a photograph of soldiers preparing equipment. Soldiers in uniforms and hats are gathered on a dirt surface next to railway tracks, laying out and inspecting large pieces of fabric. The soldiers are focused on organizing or folding the material. Additional individuals are seen in the background closer to the train tracks, observing the activity. The photograph is sepia-toned and provides a historical glimpse into a moment of logistics or preparation, possibly involving military operations. The scene shows the soldiers' coordinated effort with the materials, conveying discipline and readiness.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Sailor
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a sailor's uniform with a mustache and short hair. He is facing slightly right, with his head turned towards the camera. The uniform includes a cap with the inscription "U.S.S. Monadnock" and a sailor's collar with a scarf. The man is surrounded by an ornate floral frame with roses and other foliage, and there is text below the portrait that reads "La-Cheong" and "Hongkong."

artworks.title: Matthew, Mary, and Lawrence Taylor
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of three people: an adult woman, an adult man, and an infant. The image captures the upper three-quarters of the woman's body and the seated man, with the infant held in his lap. The woman is standing, slightly angled towards the camera, with a neutral expression. Her hair is styled neatly back from her face, and she is wearing a high-necked dress with puffed sleeves and layered detailing at the chest. The man, who is seated, has a serious expression and is wearing a suit with a bow tie. His short hair is closely cropped. The infant, held by the man, is gazing slightly to the side and is dressed in a white gown with ruffled edges. The background has a soft, diffused appearance, with a subtle decoration or pattern slightly visible, suggesting a backdrop.

artworks.title: "Woodmen of the World Drill Team"
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a parade scene. The photograph shows a line of uniformed individuals marching down a street, as onlookers are gathered on both sides. The onlookers are dressed in attire typical of the early 20th century, including hats and long dresses. The photograph is in sepia tone. Signs indicating "W.O.W. Drill Team" and "Labor Day 1910" are visible. The background shows structures with spectators watching from steps and sidewalks, adding to the impression of a public ceremony or festive occasion. The cobblestone street adds a historical context to the setting.

artworks.title: "Jack Johnson, Champion of the World"

artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on a piano bench next to a grand piano. He is wearing a dark suit with a bow tie, and his hands are positioned on the bench and knee. His face is neutral with short hair. A plush armchair is nearby, along with a decorative curtain and artwork on the walls.

artworks.title: Luray, Virginia
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated on a porch, facing the camera. She has dark hair, wearing light-colored clothing and a shawl, with a calm expression. In the background, there is a wooden porch with a house visible behind her.

artworks.title: "Booker T. Washington and Distinguished Guests, Tuskegee Institute, Alabama"
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image is a sepia-toned photograph of a group of men standing together outdoors. They are arranged in a semi-grouped formation on the steps of a building. The man at the center, likely Booker T. Washington, has short hair and is clean-shaven. He wears a three-piece suit and holds a small book or notebook. Other men of varying ages surround him, wearing dark suits with waistcoats and ties. Some individuals are holding hats. The background shows a brick building partially covered by climbing ivy.

artworks.title: "An Arithmetic Class, Tuskegee, Alabama"
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: This is a photograph of an arithmetic classroom setting with students working at a blackboard. The image captures the interior of a classroom where rows of wooden desks are occupied, facing a large blackboard covered in arithmetic problems written in chalk. Several students are standing at the blackboard, seemingly solving these mathematical equations. On the walls above the blackboard, there is framed artwork or photographs. The photograph provides depth and dimension to the classroom scene, making the arrangement of desks and students more vivid. Details such as books and papers are visible on the desks.

artworks.description: This is a photograph of a large gathering at an outdoor event. The photograph is in sepia tone, capturing a bustling crowd surrounding a central pathway amidst buildings and trees. Distinct flags are visible, including the American flag. The attendees are dressed in period clothing, indicative of the late 19th or early 20th century, with many wearing hats, and some standing while others sit in carriages or look on from various vantage points. The scene appears festive or ceremonial.

artworks.description: This is a photograph of a group of children standing in front of a wooden church building. The children are dressed in a mix of light and dark colored clothing. The background includes the church, trees, and a white picket fence.

artworks.title: "Posing for Her First Picture"
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly woman standing slightly leaning against a stack of logs. She is facing forward with her body and her right hand resting on the logs. Her left hand holds what seems to be a closed umbrella or parasol. She has distinctive facial features, including high cheekbones and a kind expression, dark skin, and a defined jawline. She wears a dark shawl, a long sleeve dress, a light-colored apron tied around her waist, a dark bonnet covering most of her hair, small earrings in each ear. In the background, there is a wooden structure resembling a shed, a board pathway cutting through an area filled with wood, and a large tree. The setting appears to be outdoors in a rustic environment.

artworks.title: "Colored Veterans of the 15th Regiment, 369th Infantry, Marching up Fifth Avenue, New York City"
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a parade marching through a city street lined with spectators. It captures a group of uniformed individuals marching in rows through an urban environment, flanked by an audience along the sidewalk. The background features tall buildings with American flags. Street lamps and architecture contribute to the historical feel of the image, suggesting an early 20th-century setting. The perspective and sepia tone enhance the historical atmosphere, capturing a moment of order, attention, and public interest.

artworks.title: Doughoregan Manor, Maryland
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a stately home surrounded by tall trees, with a lawn and several buildings visible. Details like the trees and buildings are depicted with soft brushstrokes. The color palette is sepia-toned and the image has a vignette effect.

artworks.title: Doughoregan Manor, Maryland
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: A stately mansion is shown from a slightly elevated angle with a circular frame. Tall trees obscure the horizon. The mansion has a symmetrical facade with windows, shutters, and a grand entrance with columns. A person in period clothing is in the garden, which has various shrubs and trees. A large tree with hanging foliage is on the left. The image is in sepia tones, giving a vintage look.

artworks.title: Doughoregan Manor, Maryland
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people and horses on a grassy area in front of a white classical-style building. Surrounding trees frame the scene, creating a sense of enclosure. The photograph has a sepia tone, with a soft focus on the figures and building, and a slightly blurred effect on the trees in the distance.

artworks.title: Doughoregan Manor, Maryland
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image is a sepia-toned photograph taken from a slightly elevated perspective of a garden with a path leading towards a house framed by trees and foliage. A woman in period attire stands on the path looking towards the house. The horizon is obscured by trees and the house. The photograph has a soft quality with gentle contrasts blending the elements harmoniously. The color palette is warm and subdued with shades of brown dominating the scene. The garden opens up to reveal more of the path leading to the house's entrance.

artworks.title: "Freedman's Village"
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with uniform buildings along a dirt road. The horizon is high with the line of buildings leading to a vanishing point. The structures, likely wooden houses, line both sides of the road and recede into the distance. The photo has a monochromatic color palette with sepia tones. A group of people, including adults and children, are seen along the road, engaged in various activities or standing in groups. More individuals can be seen in the distance. The image conveys a sense of community within a structured environment.

artworks.title: Bishop James Walker Hood
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a man facing the camera in a seated position. He has distinct facial features with a full beard and mustache. The man wears a dark jacket with a high collar and a white shirt underneath. The background is plain and monochromatic. A card with handwritten text is placed below the image.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Boy
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a full-length portrait of a person standing upright with a hand resting on the back of a wicker chair and the other hand on their hip. The person has medium-length, textured hair that frames their face. Their facial expression is neutral. They are dressed in a light-colored, long-sleeved shirt with a decorative bow tie at the neck and dark knee-length shorts with button details on the sides. The outfit is completed with striped socks and lace-up shoes. The background is an indoor studio setting with a plain backdrop, giving the image a sepia-toned vintage look. The floor is covered with what appears to be a fur or wool carpet.

artworks.title: "Jubilee Singers, Fisk University, Nashville, Tennessee"
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of nine men and women posing for a formal photograph. Some individuals are seated, while others stand behind. The men have short, neatly styled hair and wear suits with bow ties or neckties. The women have their hair pulled back or styled elegantly and wear long dresses with high necklines and long sleeves. One woman seated holds a circular object in her lap. The background shows a plain wall and a draped curtain, creating a studio setting. Each person has a calm expression. The photograph is mounted on orange card stock.

artworks.title: University Singers of New Orleans
artworks.creditLine: Ross J. Kelbaugh Collection, Purchased with support from the Ford Foundation
artworks.description: The sepia-toned photograph shows a group of nine individuals arranged in three rows. All are visible from the waist up, dressed in formal Victorian attire. The men wear suits and ties, while the women wear dresses with high collars and ruffles. The men have various hairstyles, and the women's hair is elegantly styled. All have neutral expressions and are seated and standing in an orderly fashion. The background is a plain backdrop, with the names "University Singers of New Orleans" and "In Aid of Colored Orphans' Home of Louisiana" printed along the edges of the photo card.
